name: Get access token (debug)
description: Debug only: shows the raw token response from the SIS. You don't need to run this first; every other request in this collection gets a token automatically. Use it when calls fail with 401/403 to check the token URL, client ID and secret. Sends client_id/client_secret as HTTP Basic auth (most SIS servers). If the server wants them in the body instead, set Auth to 'No auth' and enable the client_id/client_secret rows under Body. Not used by Infinite Campus OneRoster 1.1 (that uses OAuth 1.0 signing, no token).
